title: The Best Sympathy Food Gifts to Send in 2026
summary: The best sympathy food gifts comfort people when words fall short. Here are 10 thoughtful options from iconic makers that ship nationwide on Goldbelly.
body_markdown:
Published on April 10th, 2023
Updated on September 3rd, 2026


## Because food is the most human way to say you’re thinking of someone


When someone you love loses someone, food is one of the most meaningful things you can send. It says you’re thinking of them without requiring anything from them in return. It feeds a family that’s too exhausted to cook. It shows up at the door and says: someone cares.


The best sympathy food gifts are comforting, easy to prepare, and shareable — things that work for a houseful of people gathering after a service, or a quiet evening alone. Every option below ships nationwide on Goldbelly, straight from the maker to their door.


[Browse All Sympathy Gifts on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/sympathy-gifts)


## **The Best Sympathy Food Gifts to Send**


### **** **Zucker’s Bagel and Smoked Fish Brunch**


A New York City staple for nearly 20 years, Zucker’s makes bagels the old-fashioned way — hand-rolled, kettle-boiled, and baked to perfection using natural flours and ingredients. This brunch kit includes a dozen bagels, housemade granola, smoked fish, coffee, and all the fixings. It’s the kind of spread that feeds a crowd and feels like a hug.


**[Order Zucker’s Bagel Brunch Box](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/zuckers-bagels-and-smoked-fish/biggest-holiday-bagel-brunch-for-12)**


### **** **** **** **Ceci-Cela Patisserie’s Breakfast Basket**


What started in 1991 as a boutique bakeshop in Manhattan has become the go-to for authentic French pastries in New York City. From French pastry chef Laurent Dupal, this breakfast basket is an assortment of freshly baked croissants, muffins, danishes, and brioche buns. Light, beautiful, and something a little different.


**[Order Ceci-Cela Breakfast Basket](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/ceci-cela-patisserie/ceci-cela-breakfast-basket)**


### **** **** **** **** **The Nuns of New Skete’s Sampler Cheesecake**


A small monastery in upstate New York, the Nuns of New Skete make what many believe to be the finest cheesecakes in the country — handmade, in limited quantities, every day, just as they have for nearly four decades. The Sampler Cheesecake combines their four best-selling flavors: Classic, Kahlua, Raspberry Ripple, and Chocolate. There’s something quietly comforting about a gift made by hand in a place like this.


**[Order Sampler Cheesecake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/new-skete-monastery/sampler-cheesecake)**


### **** **** **** **** **** **Ideal Cheese Shop’s Around the World Gift Basket**


What started as a mom-and-pop butter and egg company in 1954 became a gourmet New York City cheese shop named World’s Best by Forbes. This gift basket includes five cheeses from five countries — Manchego, Comte, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Jersey Girl, and Prima Donna — along with crackers and jam. A beautiful, shareable spread for a gathering or a quiet night in.


**[Order Around the World Cheese Gift Basket](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/ideal-cheese-shop/around-the-world-cheese-gift-basket)**


### **** **** **** **** **** **** **Melissa’s Produce’s Variety Fruit Basket**


From its founding in a small rented room to its standing as the largest specialty produce distributor in the United States, Melissa’s has remained family-run since the beginning. This fruit basket ranges from everyday favorites like apples and bananas to tropical fruits like mango, papaya, gold pineapple, and coconut, to more unexpected gems like asian pear, pepino melon, and kumquats. Fresh, nourishing, and genuinely thoughtful.


**[Order Fabulous Fruit Fare](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/melissas-produce/fabulous-fruit-fare)**


### **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **Kings BBQ’s Carolina Pulled Pork Sandwiches**


Kings BBQ was founded more than 75 years ago in Kinston, North Carolina, when Wilbur King started cooking using family recipes and traditional Southern methods. Three generations later, Kings is now renowned for its hand-chopped pork, slow-smoked, pulled, and doused with a mild vinegar sauce in the true North Carolina tradition. This pack includes enough pulled pork, buns, and coleslaw for 12 sandwiches, plus hush puppies. It’s a meal that feeds a crowd.


**[Order Carolina Pulled Pork Sandwiches](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/kings-bbq/18650-carolina-pulled-pork-sandwich-pack)**


### **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **Cake Chicago’s Gluten-Free Gift Box**


When owner Mary Winslow left her publishing sales job and started baking in 2000, she became one of Chicago’s most beloved pastry makers. This assortment of chocolate truffles, brownies, and cookies is completely gluten-free — a thoughtful choice when you’re not sure about dietary restrictions.


**[Order Gluten Free Gift Box](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/cake-chicago/no-grain-no-pain-gluten-free-gift-box)**


### **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **Eli Zabar’s Build-a-Sandwich Basket**


One of New York’s leading food impresarios since 1973, Eli Zabar is synonymous with the city’s best baked goods, smoked fish, and Jewish deli specialties. This basket takes all the guesswork out of lunch: fresh-baked rye and brioche, spicy and sweet salami, cheeses, and mustard. Easy to prepare, easy to share, and deeply comforting in the way that only a great sandwich can be.


**[Order Build-a-Sandwich Basket](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/eli-zabar/build-a-sandwich-basket-for-6)**


### **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **Oasis Cafe’s Greek Pastry Bite Sampler**


Mike Amvros emigrated from Greece to Queens, New York, in 1975, and 11 years later he opened his first business, Oasis Cafe. Since then, the bakery has become a cornerstone of the community. This sampler pack of classic Oasis treats includes bite-size Coconut Baklava, Chocolate Pistachio Baklava, Kataifi, and Tulumbakia. Something a little unexpected and genuinely special.


**[Order Greek Pastry Bite Sampler](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/oasis-cafe/greek-pastry-bite-sampler-60-pack)**


### **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **Martha Stewart’s Banana Pudding**


Martha Stewart’s Banana Pudding from her eponymous brand is one of Goldbelly’s most beloved comfort food gifts. Layers of creamy vanilla pudding, fresh bananas, and wafers, made to Martha’s exacting standards and shipped nationwide. It’s simple, nostalgic, and exactly the kind of thing that makes someone feel taken care of.


**[Order Martha Stewart’s Banana Pudding](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/martha-stewart/marthas-banana-pudding-4-pack)**
